name: Waste Not

text.fail: Every food card that has left the game lands on the waste pile, and morale drops by 1.
text.bonus: Two cards beyond the need lift morale by 1.

notes: Official name Waste Not (was our No Waste). Food symbol; every food card removed from the game goes to the waste pile (settles conflict C3: the direction is removed to waste), then lose 1 morale. Id and hook name kept for saves.
